svg.aria-label: Tracking off versus on, on the real frame
svg.title: Tracking off versus on, on the real frame
svg.text: With tracking on, every symbol stays near the centre of its bin
correction the tracker applied: +45 Hz by the end
without tracking: the peak slides to the bin edge, then reads in the NEXT bin
offset from bin centre, WITHOUT tracking
Same recording, same symbols. Without tracking, 38 of the last symbols were read one bin high — harmless only because the drift was upward.
